% A shading and a tiling pattern: pgf paints both through DeviceRGB.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{patterns}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \shade[left color=red,right color=blue] (0,0) rectangle (3,2);
  \fill[pattern=north east lines,pattern color=green!50!black] (4,0) rectangle (7,2);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
